slots.notes: Primary sans socket (display + body roles) carrying the two-column header — the clamp(25px,4vw,52px) h2 title at line-height 1.08 and the muted right-column body paragraph at clamp(16px,1.25vw,19px)/1.6 — plus every card h3 (16px) and card description (15px). Native = IBM Plex Sans (weights 400, 500), loaded from Google Fonts (preconnect googleapis + gstatic) and exposed as the --font-sans CSS var with a ui-sans-serif/system-ui fallback stack. Substitute must read cleanly at a large 52px display weight and at small 15px card-body size.

Monospace socket carrying every technical/code voice in the section: the gold .eyebrow label (16px uppercase), the terminal-window and golden API-spec code blocks (11px pre), the compliance-row small labels (10px uppercase) and strong values (14px), the 28-char x 10-line binary-art padlock map (clamp(10px,0.9vw,12px), where the typed 1s and 0s MUST stay column-aligned to form the lock shape), and the asset-table label/value cells (11px). Native = IBM Plex Mono (weights 400, 500), loaded from Google Fonts and exposed as --font-mono with an SF Mono/ui-monospace fallback. Substitute MUST be a true fixed-width monospace or the ASCII-art padlock and the bordered tables break.

fontRoles.display: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
fontRoles.body: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

mechanic: A static, motionless gold-on-warm-black security features block: a two-column header (left eyebrow + large sans headline, right bottom-aligned body) over a 3-up grid of tall sharp-cornered cards, each a 2-row copy-then-visual grid whose visual is built entirely from CSS/typed text — Card 1 overlaps a dark macOS-dot terminal window with a gold-bordered API-spec card, Card 2 stacks three compliance badge rows with pure-CSS gold checkmark circles, Card 3 sets a 28x10 monospace binary-art padlock above a bordered label/value asset table.
techDelivery: Vanilla single-section Vite project (vite ^5.4.2, type:module, dev/build/preview scripts) of plain index.html + styles.css + an empty/minimal script.js, no frameworks; all visuals are hand-authored CSS (gradients, borders, pseudo-element checkmarks) and literal HTML text, with the two IBM Plex families loaded via Google Fonts preconnect+link.
reskinNotes:
This template ships ZERO image/video/icon/svg assets — every visual is hand-authored CSS or typed text, so the only fillable sockets are the two webfonts plus color tokens. Two visuals are literal text baked into markup, not data: Card 3's padlock is a 28-character-wide, 10-line block of 1s and 0s inside a 
 whose exact glyph grid forms the lock (it only works in a true monospace and a different character count or proportional font destroys the shape), and Card 1's terminal/spec panels hardcode the 'nimbus auth login / VAULT-9AMP' session and the 'openapi: 3.0.0 / Nimbus API' spec text. The palette is only PARTLY tokenized: the section background is its own #120f0a (separate from the page --bg #17130d) plus two inline radial-gradient gold glows rgba(234,208,154,0.12)/rgba(255,216,121,0.07); each .security-card bakes a near-black #0f0c08 base under an inline white-alpha linear-gradient; the terminal window uses rgba(8,7,5,0.86), the API-spec card rgba(64,52,30,0.86) with a rgba(234,208,154,0.38) gold border, the compliance rows rgba(48,39,23,0.84)/rgba(234,208,154,0.28); the CSS checkmark strokes are literal #211a0e borders; and many text colors are raw alpha values (rgba(255,247,222,0.9/0.6/0.56/0.52), rgba(255,244,213,0.68), rgba(234,208,154,0.72/0.58)) rather than the --accent/--ink/--muted vars, so recoloring means editing those rules, not just the tokens. All copy (eyebrow 'Security', the headline, the right-column paragraph, all three card headings + descriptions, the compliance standard labels SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / GDPR and their values, and the asset-table rows Reserved tier 24 TiB / Transfer lane EU Central / Revision Q603) is hardcoded in HTML. Layout is font-metric-dependent: the headline uses clamp() sizing and a max-width:820px, the card copy 
 is capped at max-width:330px, and the absolutely-positioned terminal (min(58%,230px)) and spec (min(58%,238px)) panels overlap inside a fixed 300px-min-height visual area, so a wider substitute font can reflow the heading or crowd the overlap.
